plugins.name: workflow-en

plugins.name: speak-human
plugins.description: 中文版:让 Claude 说人话、会提问——提问前自检清单 + 表达纪律,规则源自 548 次真实抉择记录挖掘;touch ~/.claude/.speak-human-always 常驻

plugins.name: speak-human-en
plugins.description: English version: make Claude speak human and ask well — pre-question self-check + expression discipline, mined from 548 real decision records; touch ~/.claude/.speak-human-always for always-on

plugins.name: send-to
plugins.description: 中文版:/send-to <会话名> 把消息转达给本机另一个 Claude Code 会话——会话名模糊匹配、多命中/零命中亮列表、消息自包含、如实汇报挂起状态、跨账号窗口识别与文件交接降级(需 Claude Code v2.1.224+,macOS/Linux)

plugins.name: send-to-en
plugins.description: English version: /send-to <session-name> relays a message to another Claude Code session on this machine — fuzzy name matching, list-on-ambiguity, self-contained messages, honest held-delivery reporting, cross-account window detection with file-handoff fallback (needs Claude Code v2.1.224+, macOS/Linux)
